predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Charlton vs Lincoln: Expected Goals, Defensive Absences & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: With Lincoln holding a 1.33 to 0.95 xG/game edge against a depleted Charlton defense and both sides struggling to finish big chances, Draw / Away Win represents the most grounded full-time trajectory.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win anchored by a 1:1 stalemate and Lincoln's superior chance creation against Charlton's defensive absentees (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals & BTTS: Yes reflecting porous backlines combined with 65%+ big-chance waste rates on both sides (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Charlton Second-Half Response vs Defensive Fatigue if Matty Godden exploits Lincoln's inability to protect half-time leads (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Lincoln's 1.33 xG attack tests Charlton's injury-hit backline at The Valley.

spf.comment: Covers the modal 1:1 stalemate from both teams' finishing waste and the 1:2 away-win script driven by Lincoln's 0.38 xG/game edge against Charlton's defensive absences; neither single outcome captures both supported mechanisms alone.

over_under.comment: Both teams waste roughly two-thirds of their big chances (65.2% vs 66.7%), supporting the 53.6% Poisson Under 2.5 baseline and Charlton's 62.5% home Under 2.5 rate.

btts.comment: Both sides concede near 1.50 xGA per game with low overall clean-sheet rates (18.8% home, 25.0% away), giving each attack a clear route to at least one goal.

score.comment: 1:1 leads the Poisson matrix (12.7%) as both sides trade single goals, while 1:2 reflects Lincoln converting their xG advantage against Charlton's thinned backline.

goals.comment: 2 goals (25.5%) and 3 goals (21.5%) represent the two highest-probability Poisson goal counts across the primary 1:1 and secondary 1:2 scenarios.

bqc.comment: Charlton have drawn 75.0% of home first halves and Lincoln 62.5% of away first halves, pointing to a level interval before either holding 1:1 or Lincoln striking late.
